evidence: The audit gate is red for a reason that predates this turn — let me pin it down precisely and record it.
observation: kgkit eval --quick reported evidence coverage 46,837/51,459 (90.2% of edges, 94.3% of nodes) with 4,622 records missing: 4,052 associated_with pairs and 570 disease nodes, because the sidecar still indexed the pre-migration JSON extracts. Deriving it from the release with the declaration's own identity rule brought it to 51,459/51,459 and all audit, pruning and QA suites passed.
subject: F-105
title: Audit gate was red because the evidence sidecar ignored the migration
